value.rationale: The full positive conditional distribution at the singular all-zero-leaf boundary is a natural unresolved observable of the 2026 motivating study. The result proves a sharp three-regime scale based on depth times rare positive density, identifies a nontrivial countable-state nonlinear kinetic law in total variation, and supplies an explicit error bound plus measurable one-atom formula. This goes beyond the previously invariant zero atom and a mere routine finite computation.
